title: Pionex 1D/4H historical backfill 429-safe shared cooldown, immutable page cache, automatic retry
changes: Fix Pionex 429 storm: both latest and historical Worker K-line requests consult a shared R2 rate-limit cooldown before contacting the upstream API.
Cache verified native-Pionex historical pages by symbol/interval/endTime/limit; cached historical pages remain usable during an upstream cooldown.
Propagate upstream Retry-After from the Worker and automatically retry pending user-requested 1D/4H history after bounded exponential cooldown, never in a busy loop or while hidden.
Remove immediate direct-Pionex fallback upon Worker failure to avoid extra calls and prolonged IP bans.
Maintain normal initial 1D 95 / 4H 130, viewport drag/zoom, deep cache, indicators, 7D bounds and RR unchanged.
Show waiting-for-rate-limit state and preserve all already fetched K lines during a temporary ban.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite radar files in GitHub and deploy cloudflare/worker.js to existing white-meadow-16bc Cloudflare Worker.
validationNote: Offline Worker and Chromium tests use mocked Pionex/R2 responses; true Pionex 429 expiry and available historical depth require post-deployment verification.
